about.subtitle: Technology · Entrepreneurship · Cybersecurity · Marketing
paragraphs: I'm Vishwa Kumar (also known as Vishwa K), Founder & CEO at Zinoin Group, established in August 2025. My core specialization bridges cybersecurity engineering, network security defense, full-stack software development, and performance digital marketing.

Currently pursuing my B.E. in Cybersecurity Engineering at Sri Sai Ranganathan Engineering College, Coimbatore (CGPA: 8.5/10), I focus on building defensive systems including autonomous cyber defense networks, deceptive honeypot traps, AI data confidentiality shields (DLP), and phishing log analytics.

My commercial experience includes architecting enterprise AI retrieval systems (DocuMind AI), high-security order transaction software, and scalable digital infrastructure balancing defensive security hygiene with practical business growth.

Proficient across TCP/IP networking, Linux administration, Python, Java, SQL, Wireshark, Nmap, and cloud security frameworks (AWS IAM, VPC), I engineer resilient solutions that protect mission-critical data.
